title: headwater-inventory/1
description: Printed by `headwater inventory --json`: the total of each elementary flow over a product's whole life cycle, with no method, for a database, a study or a background process. Example, in the folder of `headwater demo`: `headwater inventory project/tshirt-footprint --json`.

path.description: The database or study folder, as given. Null for a background process.

name.description: The name of the database or the study, or the id of the background process.

scenario.description: The scenario of the study the scores are calculated in, from `--scenario`. Null for none.

release.description: The release the background was read from, as name@hash. Null for a folder.

folder.description: The folder the background was read from. Null for a release.

background.description: The background the scores are calculated on.

methods.description: The id of each method the background was loaded with. The method does not change the totals.

flow.description: `--flow`: only the flows whose name holds this text, case ignored.

compartment.description: `--compartment`: only the flows of this compartment and of those under it.

top.description: `--top`: how many flows to list per unit. Null for all of them.

engine_version.description: The version of headwater that calculated the scores.

id.description: The id of the process that makes the product.

amount.description: How much of what the process makes: 1, or a study's amount of it.

flow_count.description: How many elementary flows the inventory has, before the filters.

compartment.description: Where the flow goes or comes from, such as `air` or `natural resource/in water`. Null for a flow with no compartment.

unit.description: The reference unit of the flow.

amount.description: The total, with the sign of the lines: a flow whose lines cancel out can be 0.

flows.description: The flows the filters keep and `--top` lists, by unit, then largest first.

rest.description: For each unit that `--top` cuts, the flows it leaves out, summed and counted.

sums.description: Only with `--flow` or `--compartment`: for each unit, the sum of the flows that match, and how many they are.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the inputs of the result the inventory is read from.

pin.description: The background the database or the study pins, as written. For a background process, the background: `toy-background@6864b7dbb65d`, or `folder` and its path.

residual.description: The largest residual of the solves.

provenance.description: Where the inventory comes from. A background process has only `pin`.

results.description: One inventory per product: the one product of a database, each product of a study, or the background process.
